font.reason: Poster/impact display face standing in for Helvetica 800 caps; single weight so no fake bold; wordSpacing .15em for its tight word gap.

comps.translatedSummary: LAUNCH WEEK -> «هفتهٔ عرضه»; underline splits into 28 spectrum bars for two bars of music, then collapses back to the exact line.

rtlDecisions.why: Bass-to-treble is a category axis read in reading order; bar i=0 (tallest bass bar) now sits at the right end, envelope falls to the left. Slot x = N-1-i; per-index wobble/jitter/env maths and seeds unchanged.
Symmetric about the canvas centre, so the collapse into the line is pixel-identical; bars grow upward from the line (gravity).
textAlign center is direction neutral; FaRoot adds direction rtl.

Removed letterSpacing -1 and Helvetica caps; Lalezar faText(150) = 165px, lineHeight 1.3, top 310 so the taller Persian glyph box and descender clear the bars; size raised vs 120 because the two-word Persian headline is narrower than the Latin caps.

rtlDecisions.what: Timing, easing, gap/width interpolation, conditional mount of the solid line
rtlDecisions.why: Motion fidelity; 25f split, 64f dance, 12f collapse, static tail.

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets in this demo.
concerns: Registry duration is 64f but design is ~141f; verified with --duration 141 and the full video rendered with it.
lessons: Frequency/spectrum bar charts are category axes: mirror the slot order only (x = N-1-i) and keep the per-index maths so seeds/beats stay identical.
